requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.text: The TCU shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: The TCU shall carry the international approval mark described in paragraph 5.3 on every unit conforming to the approved type.

requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: The TCU shall have its approval mark affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The TCU approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The TCU approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The TCU shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, complies with the requirements of UN R10.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: The TCU shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The TCU shall not exceed 62 to 52 dBµV/m broadband radiated emissions in the 30 to 75 MHz band, decreasing logarithmically above 30 MHz.

requirements.quote: and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
requirements.text: The TCU shall not exceed 52 to 63 dBµV/m broadband radiated emissions in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically above 75 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: The TCU shall not exceed a constant 63 dBµV/m broadband radiated emission limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The TCU shall show measured broadband radiated emission values below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The TCU shall not exceed 52 to 42 dBµV/m narrowband radiated emissions in the 30 to 75 MHz band, decreasing logarithmically above 30 MHz.

requirements.quote: and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
requirements.text: The TCU shall not exceed 42 to 53 dBµV/m narrowband radiated emissions in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically above 75 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: The TCU shall not exceed a constant 53 dBµV/m narrowband radiated emission limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The TCU shall show measured narrowband radiated emission values below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
requirements.text: The TCU shall withstand, over 90 per cent of the 20 MHz to 2 GHz band, 60 V/m stripline, 75 V/m TEM cell, 60 mA BCI, 30 V/m ALSE or 21 V/m reverberation chamber, depending on the method applied.

requirements.quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 10 V/m 7 V/m
requirements.text: The TCU shall withstand, over 90 per cent of the 2 to 6 GHz band, 10 V/m in ALSE or 7 V/m in a reverberation chamber, depending on the method applied.

requirements.quote: Test level below 2 GHz 50 V/m 62,5 V/m 50 mA 25 V/m 18 V/m
requirements.text: The TCU shall withstand, over the whole 20 MHz to 2 GHz band, a minimum of 50 V/m stripline, 62.5 V/m TEM cell, 50 mA BCI, 25 V/m ALSE or 18 V/m reverberation chamber.

requirements.quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 8 V/m 6 V/m
requirements.text: The TCU shall withstand, over the whole 2 to 6 GHz band, a minimum of 8 V/m in ALSE or 6 V/m in a reverberation chamber.

requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.text: The TCU shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity related functions during the radiated immunity tests of Annex 9.

requirements.quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b
requirements.text: The TCU shall be tested for conducted transient immunity on its 12 V supply lines using the starting profile of ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)
requirements.text: The TCU shall meet functional status B when related to immunity related functions and status D otherwise for the starting profile, with 10 pulses for a 12 V system.

requirements.quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
requirements.text: The TCU shall meet functional performance status III for test pulse 1 at -75 V on a 12 V system over 500 pulses.

requirements.quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III
requirements.text: The TCU shall meet functional performance status I for immunity related functions and III otherwise for test pulse 2a at +37 V over 500 pulses.

requirements.quote: 2b +10 V +20 V 10 pulses II III
requirements.text: The TCU shall meet functional performance status II for immunity related functions and III otherwise for test pulse 2b at +10 V over 10 pulses.

requirements.quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
requirements.text: The TCU shall meet functional performance status I for immunity related functions and III otherwise for test pulse 3a at -112 V for 1 hour.

requirements.quote: 3b +75 V +150 V 1 h I III
requirements.text: The TCU shall meet functional performance status I for immunity related functions and III otherwise for test pulse 3b at +75 V for 1 hour.

requirements.quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
requirements.text: The TCU, where it is not switched and contains no switches or inductive load, is exempt from the transient conducted emission test of paragraph 6.7.

requirements.quote: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode. Wanted emissions (e.g. from RF transmitting systems) within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded
requirements.text: The TCU's cellular RF transmitter shall be tested in transmit mode, with wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth and out-of-band emissions disregarded.

requirements.quote: Spurious emissions are subject to this Regulation.
requirements.text: The TCU shall keep spurious emissions within the limits of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2.
requirements.text: The TCU shall be manufactured so that production-sample emission levels do not exceed the reference limits by more than 4 dB.

requirements.quote: the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1.
requirements.text: The TCU shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity related functions up to the conducted disturbance levels of paragraph 6.9.1 in production verification.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The TCU's cyber security approval mark, where affixed, shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall protect the vehicle type against risks identified in the vehicle manufacturer’s risk assessment. Proportionate mitigations shall be implemented to protect the vehicle type.
requirements.text: The TCU shall implement proportionate mitigations protecting the vehicle type against the risks identified in the risk assessment.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall implement measures for the vehicle type to: (a) Detect and prevent cyber-attacks against vehicles of the vehicle type;
requirements.text: The TCU shall implement measures to detect and prevent cyber-attacks against the vehicle.

requirements.quote: (c) Provide data forensic capability to enable analysis of attempted or successful cyber-attacks.
requirements.text: The TCU shall provide data forensic capability enabling analysis of attempted or successful cyber-attacks.

requirements.quote: Cryptographic modules used for the purpose of this Regulation shall be in line with consensus standards.
requirements.text: The TCU's cryptographic modules used for cyber security shall be in line with consensus standards.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives
requirements.text: The TCU shall verify the authenticity and integrity of every message it receives over its external and in-vehicle communication channels.

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys (e.g., use of Hardware Security Modules)
requirements.text: The TCU shall implement security controls for storing cryptographic keys, such as a hardware security module.

requirements.quote: Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect system data/code
requirements.text: The TCU shall apply access control techniques and designs to protect its system data and code from unauthorised manipulation, overwrite or erasure.

requirements.quote: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected
requirements.text: The TCU shall protect confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle.

requirements.quote: Measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack shall be employed
requirements.text: The TCU shall employ measures to detect and recover from denial of service attacks on its communication channels and internal network.

requirements.quote: Measures to prevent and detect unauthorized access shall be employed
requirements.text: The TCU shall employ measures to prevent and detect unauthorised access, including attempts to gain privileged access.

requirements.quote: Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity should be considered
requirements.text: The TCU, acting as gateway, shall implement measures to detect malicious internal CAN/Ethernet messages.

requirements.quote: Secure software update procedures shall be employed
requirements.text: The TCU shall employ secure over-the-air software update procedures.

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to systems that have remote access
requirements.text: The TCU, as a system with remote access, shall apply security controls protecting its remotely operable functions.

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to external interfaces
requirements.text: The TCU shall apply security controls to its external interfaces, including the vehicle diagnostic interface and any exposed ports.

requirements.quote: Cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development shall be followed
requirements.text: The TCU shall be developed following cyber security best practices for software and hardware, removing development remainders such as debug or JTAG ports.

requirements.quote: Cybersecurity testing with adequate coverage
requirements.text: The TCU shall undergo cyber security testing with adequate coverage to verify the effectiveness of the implemented security measures.

requirements.quote: The authenticity and integrity of software updates shall be protected to reasonably prevent their compromise and reasonably prevent invalid updates.
requirements.text: The TCU shall protect the authenticity and integrity of OTA software updates to prevent their compromise and invalid updates.

requirements.quote: Each RXSWIN shall be uniquely identifiable.
requirements.text: The TCU shall make each RXSWIN it holds uniquely identifiable.

requirements.quote: Each RXSWIN shall be easily readable in a standardized way via the use of an electronic communication interface, at least by the standard interface (OBD port).
requirements.text: The TCU shall make each RXSWIN or declared software version easily readable via a standardized electronic communication interface, at least through the OBD port.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall protect the RXSWINs and/or software version(s) on a vehicle against unauthorised modification.
requirements.text: The TCU shall protect the RXSWINs and software versions it stores against unauthorised modification.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall ensure that the vehicle is able to restore systems to their previous version in case of a failed or interrupted update or that the vehicle can be placed into a safe state after a failed or interrupted update.
requirements.text: The TCU shall restore target ECUs to their previous software version, or place the vehicle into a safe state, after a failed or interrupted update.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall ensure that software updates can only be executed when the vehicle has enough power to complete the update process
requirements.text: The TCU shall only execute a software update when the vehicle has enough power to complete the update, including any recovery or safe-state transition.

requirements.quote: When the execution of an update may affect the safety of the vehicle, the vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate how the update will be executed safely.
requirements.text: Where an update may affect vehicle safety, the TCU shall use technical means ensuring the vehicle is in a state in which the update can be executed safely.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate that the vehicle user is able to be informed about an update before the update is executed.
requirements.text: The TCU shall inform the vehicle user, before execution, of the update's purpose, functional changes, expected duration, unavailable functionalities and necessary instructions.

requirements.quote: In the situation where the execution of an update whilst driving may not be safe, the vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate how they will: (a) Ensure the vehicle cannot be driven during the execution of the update;
requirements.text: Where executing the update while driving is unsafe, the TCU shall ensure the vehicle cannot be driven during execution of the update.

requirements.quote: (b) Ensure that the driver is not able to use any functionality of the vehicle that would affect the safety of the vehicle or the successful execution of the update.
requirements.text: Where executing the update while driving is unsafe, the TCU shall disable the vehicle functionalities that would affect vehicle safety or the successful execution of the update.

requirements.quote: After the execution of an update the vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate how the following will be implemented: (a) The vehicle user is able to be informed of the success (or failure) of the update;
requirements.text: The TCU shall inform the vehicle user of the success or failure of an executed update.

requirements.quote: (b) The vehicle user is able to be informed about the changes implemented and any related updates to the user manual (if applicable).
requirements.text: The TCU shall inform the vehicle user about the changes implemented by the update and any related updates to the user manual.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall ensure that preconditions have to be met before the software update is executed.
requirements.text: The TCU shall ensure defined preconditions are met before executing a software update.
